tei:div.tei:p: 305)kyai ma/ rgyal kun 'dus zhal pad 'byung mtsho rgyal de mkhyen no// mgon med nyam bdag la thugs rjes kyang gzigs mdzod/ sngon gyi 'phro dang mtsho rgyal thugs rje yi stobs kyis/ klong chen sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/ chos nyid dri bral don gzigs 'khor lor yi mgon po/ skye ba med pa'i nang don ye shes nyid gsal mdzad/ 'od gsal chos nyid klong du dag mnyam du rol yang*/ thugs rje'i tsha zer bdag cag 'gro mgon gyi bla ma/ bdag gi bsod nams dpal du legs par du shar yang*/ da res 'dus byas rang mtshangs rten 'brel la ltos nas/ mthong thos tsam yang med par bral ba de kyi hud/ shar ri'i rtse nas kun gsal bzhin ras de ngoms dus/ brtse ba'i 'dzum gyis skyong ba'i zhal bzang de dran byung*/ 'od zer 'gro ba'i mun pa rang sangs la song dus/ byams pa'i gsung gis gdams pa'i chos gsungs de dran byung*/ bar snang lha yi bdud rtsi zil ma de babs dus/ brtse ba'i thugs kyi dgongs pa'i gnad gsang de btsal nas/ thugs yid gcig dril pha phog gnang ba de dran 306)byung*/ sa gzhi me tog rtsi shing sna tshogs su rgyas dus/ gang 'dod gdams pa'i gsang mdzod chos sgo de 'byed nas/ khams dbang dang bstun dam chos stsal ba de dran byung*/ 'bras drug lo tog smin nas longs spyod du gyur dus/ rang rig ma bcos 'od gsal rang ngo de sprad nas/ rang byung ye shes ston pa'i zab lam de dran byung*/ lha lam nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa de mthong dus/ gnyis med ye shes sbyor ba'i rlabs shugs kyi stobs kyis/ kun rtog brgyad cu'i rtog pa rang grol du song bas/ zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i lam mchog de dran byung*/ bar snang skar ma'i khyu tshogs gsal sgo ru mngon dus/ 'khor slob mched grogs 'tshogs pa'i rnam dpyod de dran byung*/ shar gyi rta bdun nub ri'i phyogs cha la byon dus// yid kyi 'khri shing snying gi dwangs ma de dran byung*// 'bral med 'bral ba'i snang ba ston pa de dran byung*// kye hud kye hud mchog gsum rtsa gsum de mkhyen no// dran no dran no bdag gi bla ma nyid dran no// da ni la 'ur dam pa'i lha chos la dengs 'gro// bsags tshad zad pa'i sgyu ma'i nor rdzas des ci byed// 'dus tshad bral bas 'khor slob mnga' thang des ci byed// skyes tshad 'chi na gces pa'i

307)bu phrug des ci byed// bshad tshad brdzun pa'i phan tshun 'thab 'khon des ci byed// da ni 'khor 'das chos kun sgyu ma yi 'phrul 'dra// thams cad mi rtag sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi gzhi ma// de la zhen 'dzin 'ching ba'i ngal ba des ci byed// grogs kyang mi bsam brtse gdung yid rten ni mi mos// zas kyang mi bsam lus rten 'tsho byed ni mi bsam// gos kyang mi bsam dro 'jam byed pa ni mi gda'// gnas kyang mi bsam yid kyi 'khri shing de med pas// 'dug pa'i gnas la nges med dben ri da 'grim nas// pha gcig rtogs ldan bla ma'i gdams pa de nyams blang*// rtog med ngang du bsam med gnas lugs de bskyangs na// bsgom med sgom pa'i chos sku'i rang zhal de mjal yong*// gnas lugs ma bcos gtad med rang grol gyi spyod pa'i// dam bca' brtan pos dben rir sgrub tshugs zhig bzung nas// rang rig ma bcos gnyug ma'i dgongs pa de bskyang na// rang snang don gyi bla ma'i rang zhal de mjal byung*// rang snang zangs mdog dpal ri thag ring na mi bzhugs// rang byung lhun grub chen po'i dgongs pa la 'ub chub// rang cag bla ma mjal 'dod mched 308)grogs shig yod na// rang rig gdod ma'i btsan sa zin pa rang mdzod cig /rang byung pad+ma las 'khrungs mtsho skyes kyi rdo rje// las can 'gro ba'i dpal shar mtshan ldan gyi bla mas// gang 'brel pad+ma 'od du 'dren ston kyang mdzad 'dug /rang rtsal dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma dang bcas te// glu dbyangs sgro dang me tog bdud rtsi yi khrus nas// mi gnas 'og min zhing du ston 'khor gyi tshul du// zab rgyas gdams pa'i chos la dpal longs su spyad nas// pad 'byung yab yum thugs bzhed da lta yang 'grub 'dug /gang 'brel pad+ma 'od du sangs rgyas su smon no// de skad snying med sprang mo a nan+da'i ming can// sems rtsa sdug gis zin nas ci cha dang bral skabs// snying gi bu mchog shī la badz+ra gyi drung du// sug rtse rlung gis bskyod nas bris pa de phul lo// sgyu ma'i bu mo sgyu ma'i ltad mo la mtshar nas// da ni mi 'gyur gtan srid zin pa la smon no/
ces su kha badz+ra gyis so// dge'o//
